A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Sentry droid/Legends|'''sentry''']] was a member of [[Clan Ordo]]. In [[3954 BBY]] he joined his clan in the [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|search]] for [[Mandalore's Mask]] on [[Rekkiad]]. He was part of the group that ambushed the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Canderous Ordo]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|One more step and we paint the snow with your brains!|The sentry|<ref name="Revan" />}}
This [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry]] and a member of [[Clan Ordo]]. In [[3954 BBY]] he joined his clan in the [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|search]] for [[Mandalore's Mask]] on [[Rekkiad]]. He and [[Edric Ordo|three]] other sentries ambushed the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Canderous Ordo]] when they attempted to find Clan Ordo's campsite. He ordered the pair to lay down there weapons and identify themselves. Canderous replied that he was a member of their clan and refused to lay down his weapon. Another sentry, Edric, asked Canderous to prove that he was who he said he was. After a quick retort by Canderous the sentry and his group led Canderous and his friend to their campsite.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Clan Ordo sentry first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]].
